definition: the thing for which one is employed; work; occupation; profession; job; employment.
example_en: He has secured a good job in the bank.

definition: an interjection used to express appreciation, slight, acceptance, blessing, etc.
example_en: Hearing his friend's feat, he exclaimed, "Well done!"

definition: an alcoholic liquor distilled from wine; brandy.
example_en: He drank brandy and became intoxicated.

definition: a variety of turmeric plant.
example_en: They grew a variety of turmeric plant in the garden.

definition: to turn, tilt toward one-side.
example_en: The boat tilted to one side because of the wind.

definition: careful, systematic, patient study and investigation in some field of knowledge; research.
example_en: The scientist conducted research on that subject.

definition: a coquettish glance.
example_en: She looked at him with a coquettish glance.

definition: that which contains gems and other precious stones within.
example_en: The sea is called ratna garbha, that which contains gems within.

definition: a man who purchases; a purchaser; a buyer.
example_en: That buyer purchased a gold ornament.

definition: a very serious disease; a consumptive disease.
example_en: The patient suffering from a serious consumptive disease was admitted to the hospital.

definition: the liquid left after butter has been churned from milk or cream; buttermilk.
example: ಅಮ್ಮ ತ್ರಪ್ಸ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಪ್ಪು ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಂಬಾರ್ ಪುಡಿ ಹಾಕಿದಳು.
example_en: Mother added salt and sambar powder to the buttermilk.

definition: robbery of ships on the high seas; piracy.
example_en: Piracy used to occur frequently along this coast.

definition: the opening through which human beings take in food; the mouth.
example_en: Words came out from his mouth.

definition: to get disturbed while sleeping (as from a horrible dream, subconscious fear, etc.).
example_en: He got disturbed in his sleep at night because of a horrible dream.
